thread:
ria: Proposal: tighten postmortem follow-ups with a tiny action card + ack SLAs + cadence. TL;DR: 5-field card, 7-day default ack, 72h for P0/P1, weekly 30m remediation sync, monthly recurring-pattern review. thoughts?

sam: sounds good. what are the 5 fields?

ria: draft: Action | Owner | ETA | Risk (L/M/H) | Verify link/checklist. keep one-line action descriptions.

kai: +1. enforce 72h ack for P0/P1, else 7d default.

maria: weekly 30m sync sounds right. agenda: new actions (5m), blocked (10m), slippage (10m), closes (5m). rotate two leads.

oncall-bot: Reminder: update incident 1974999999 action items before EOD.

sam: automation idea: Slack modal to create card and post to #remediation-tracker + add row to tracker sheet.

ria: pilot plan: 2-week pilot on 3 live postmortems (infra, serving, runtime). success metrics: >80% ack within SLA, >50% items closed/in-validation after 2 weeks. I'll post template Wed.

maria: add prod-verify checklist requirement for closes. small smoke tests.

kai: escalation rule: if >7d overdue auto-ping manager and put on next weekly agenda.

sam: ops can own calendar invites; owners own items.

ria: thanks all. i'll share the doc+sheet and set pilot kickoff next Monday. will ping here with links.

oncall-bot: Pilot kickoff scheduled: 1975600000. Reminder will post 24h before.
